scenes.title: Spending, Made Smarter.
scenes.text: Meet Moniq. Your money, finally making sense. One clear view of your spending, your goals, and what comes next.

scenes.title: Your permission. Read-only access.
scenes.text: With your permission, Moniq reads financial alerts through Gmail. No bank passwords. No sending emails. Every account in this demo is synthetic.
Start with ten dollars. Confirm a four hundred dollar paycheck, and watch your balance reach four ten. Only confirmed income counts.
Now, a fifteen dollar purchase. Merchant, amount, date, account, and a machine learning category, ready for review. Confirm, and your balance updates.

scenes.title: SmartApprove · Evidence before automation
scenes.text: Meet SmartApprove. Opt in for trusted senders, set limits, and keep uncertain alerts in review. This controlled forty dollar dinner passes the rules, with an audit trail.

scenes.title: Circles · Split the bill
scenes.text: Dinner with friends? Create a Circle and split that forty dollars. Your share is twenty. Jordan owes twenty. The original bank charge stays intact.

scenes.title: Repayment ≠ paycheck income
scenes.text: Record Jordan's repayment, and the debt clears. Cash updates. Paycheck income stays the same. Clear numbers, no double counting.

scenes.title: See the impact before you spend
scenes.text: Budgets follow your share of spending. Test a purchase against your savings forecast, and see the tradeoff before you spend. Assumptions stay visible.

scenes.title: Turn a goal into a plan
scenes.text: Set a savings goal. Record your progress, choose a monthly plan, and see an estimated finish date. A plan never becomes fake cash.

scenes.title: Answers grounded in your records
scenes.text: Ask your money questions. Moniq answers from your stored records, so the numbers match the dashboard.

scenes.title: Moniq · Spending, Made Smarter.
scenes.text: Less guessing. More confidence. Moniq. Spending, Made Smarter.
